observation.visible_scene: A dusk/dawn sky over a calm body of water: deep purple-blue cloud cover above, a band of bright yellow-orange glow at the horizon, a thin silhouetted ridge of land along the bottom edge, and its reflection in the water. Small dark bird silhouettes are scattered across the sky.
visible_changes: A distant flock of tiny birds in the upper-right quadrant drifts steadily toward the top-right corner over the whole excerpt (from clustered mid-right at t=0 to spread near the top edge by t=1.33).

Several larger, closer bird silhouettes glide across the lower part of the frame just above the horizon, all moving left-to-right: a left bird travels from x~345 to x~650 while rising slightly; a middle bird travels from x~540 to x~750; a right bird travels from x~820 to the right edge and exits the frame.
These near birds enter the lower frame already in flight around t=0.57–0.60 and continue gliding rightward until the clip ends; no takeoff or landing is shown.
The cloud pattern, the horizon line, and the land silhouette remain fixed in position throughout, indicating the camera is stationary and the observed motion belongs to the birds, not to panning.
outside_clip_unknowns: The moment the near birds entered the scene and where they go after leaving the right edge are outside this segment.
The cause of the birds' flight direction and any interaction between the distant flock and the nearer birds is not shown.
uncertain_details: Whether the very slow apparent shift of the background clouds is real drift or compression artifact is indeterminate; the horizon/land position is stable, so camera motion is judged negligible.
Exact count and species of birds are not resolvable from the silhouettes.
